title.subtitle: Take your crew to Mars and bring them back home healthy
title.continue.description: Pick up your saved mission right where you left it.
title.newGame.description: Start from the preparation, on Earth.
title.newGame.confirm: Are you sure? Choose it again to confirm
title.newGame.confirmDescription: If you start another mission, your saved one is erased.
title.mode.campaign2024.description: Everything that happens really happened in 2024, in the same order.
title.mode.free.description: Each part of the trip uses different real dates.
title.length.description: You can save at any time and keep playing another day.
title.helpMode.description: Your crew runs to the shelter on their own and Mission Control gives you hints without asking.
title.controls: ↑ ↓ choose · ← → change · Enter accept · mouse works too
loadout.outbound.title: Pack the ship
loadout.outbound.subtitle: Everything you take has weight. Choose how to share the space.
loadout.profile.waterShield.description: Lots of water around the shelter: it blocks radiation, but there are few spare parts.
loadout.profile.workshop.description: Lots of spare parts to fix things fast, but little water for protection.
loadout.profile.balanced.description: A bit of everything, no extremes.
loadout.outbound.fact: Using water as a radiation shield is a real idea for designing spacecraft.
loadout.outbound.controls: ← → choose · Enter confirm · mouse works too
loadout.return.title: Cargo for the trip home
loadout.return.subtitle: The hold of the ship is small: arrange the boxes like packing a case. Whatever does not fit stays on Mars.
loadout.return.noSamples: There are no samples to take: the trip is lighter, but without science.
loadout.return.controls: Arrows move · Tab pick a piece · Space take or drop · R rotate · X put back · Enter launch · or use the mouse (right click rotates)
pause.saveAndExit: Save and go to the menu
pause.hint: The game is stopped: mission time is not passing.
settings.title: Options
title.settings.description: Music and sound volume, and the game language.
loadout.grid.pick: Pick a piece and take it to the hold:
loadout.grid.allLoaded: Nothing is left at the base: everything is on the ship!
loadout.grid.autoDone: Done: first what you need to get home and, in the space left, the best samples.
loadout.grid.confirmRed: Something important for the trip home is missing (check the red lights). Press Enter again to launch anyway.
loadout.grid.error.outside: It does not fit there: it sticks out of the hold. Try rotating it with R.
loadout.grid.error.overlap: Something is already there. Find a gap or rotate it with R.
loadout.grid.error.water: No more water at the base: drinking water and shield water come from the same tank.
